title: Chirurgie des surfaces conformes : notes manuscrites (s.d., 1983-1984), lettres (1984).

errors: Hypotheses on k are slightly loose. One needs the fixed points of all involutions in V to be k-rational, and in particular sqrt(-1) in k. Over a general field, Klein four-subgroups of PGL_2(k) need not be conjugate to the standard one: they are classified by quaternion-type data, i.e. classes mod squares. The 'closed under square roots' assumption does suffice for the stated bijections.

Characteristic 3 caveat for the NB. In characteristic 3, order-3 elements of PGL_2 are unipotent with a single fixed point. The 8 'face centres' then collapse to 4 points (wild ramification), so the description of the larger ramification set of Γ fails there. The bijection (a)-(b)-(c) itself still holds.

The orientation and antipodism description of faces is fine. The claim that Γ is exactly the group of orientation-preserving automorphisms (rather than all 48 automorphisms) is correct for PGL_2 over a field with i, since orientation corresponds to the choice of i.

ideas.what: Octahedral group S_4 in PGL_2(k) as normalizer of a Klein four-group; the 6 fixed points form the octahedron {0,∞,±1,±i}; orbits of size 6, 8, 12
ideas.modern_name: Finite subgroups of PGL_2 / Klein's octahedral group and its invariant orbits
ideas.usually_credited_to: F. Klein (Vorlesungen über das Ikosaeder, 1884); Dickson for finite fields

ideas.what: Action of Nor(V) on the 4 antipodal face-pairs gives Γ ≅ S_4, with I(V) a V-torsor (S_4 ≅ AGL_2(F_2))
ideas.modern_name: Holomorph of the Klein four-group; rotation group of the cube acting on its body diagonals

ideas.what: Orientation of the octahedral structure corresponds to a choice of sqrt(-1); category of (X,V) equivalent to category of oriented combinatorial octahedra
ideas.modern_name: Rigidity of dessins/regular maps on P^1 with Galois action on orientation (complex conjugation reverses orientation)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Esquisse, dessins d'enfants), Belyi; Jones–Singerman for regular maps
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses regular polyhedra/dessins and orientation via Galois action in general terms; this specific octahedral statement is not known to me in print

deep.surprise_reason: This is a careful, field-agnostic restatement of classical material: Klein's octahedral group, the S_4 action on face pairs, and the octahedron in P^1. It serves as preparatory bookkeeping for the conformal-surgery project. The categorical equivalence and the orientation↔sqrt(-1) remark are natural in Grothendieck's dessins framework and not new to specialists.
transcription_corrections: 'X droite projective réelle sur un corps k' is likely misread. The hypothesis seems to be 'X droite projective sur un corps alg. clos (il suffit qu'il soit stable par extraction de racines carrées) de car. ≠ 2'; 'réelle' does not fit the image or the mathematics.
'S = une des trois partitions de l'action de V sur X' should probably read 'S = ens. de ramification de l'action de V sur X'.
'NB Γ a une autre des partitions plus grande' should probably read 'NB Γ a un ens. de ramification plus grand qui comprend, en plus de S, ...'.
'Ceci résulte de la théorie combinatoire de l'octaèdre, ou des cas d'existence' ends in an unclear phrase. It looks like 'ou dans ce cas c'est kif-kif', i.e. a direct check in the standard case.
'on a une antipodisme a_S = a_V [...] par la condition' should probably read 'on a un antipodisme a_S = a_V caractérisé par la condition que pour σ ∈ V*, a_S induise des transpositions dans X^σ'.
Margin note reads roughly: 'Cas la catégorie formée des couples (X,V) (ou (X,Γ), ou (X,S)): elle est équivalente à la catégorie des structures octaédrales orientées ... q: {±i} ≅ ...'.
